title: Kestrel Dealer Wholesale Floorplan Line: One Line per Dealership
content:
**Holding rule.** A dealership holds one wholesale line; additional rooftops of the same owner each hold their own line under their own dealer number.

Under the Kestrel Dealer Wholesale Floorplan Line the unit of holding is the dealership, identified by its dealer number. The limit is 1 wholesale line per dealership. An owner with several rooftops does not combine them on a single line: each rooftop is a dealership with its own dealer number and holds its own Kestrel Dealer Wholesale Floorplan Line, graded and sized on its own.

## The rule in its parts

| Question the rule answers | Answer under the holding rule |
|---|---|
| How many wholesale lines may one dealership hold? | 1 |
| Under what identity is a line held? | The dealership's own dealer number |
| How is an additional rooftop of the same owner financed? | By its own line, held under its own dealer number |

## Illustrations (hypothetical owners)

- A hypothetical owner operates one rooftop. That dealership holds 1 Kestrel Dealer Wholesale Floorplan Line under its dealer number.
- A hypothetical owner operates three rooftops, each with its own dealer number. Each of the three dealerships holds its own Kestrel Dealer Wholesale Floorplan Line, so the owner's rooftops together hold three lines, one per dealer number, and no dealer number holds more than 1.
